intro.text: This entry describes Hoxha-Aliu syndrome (HXAL). I do not reliably remember the causal gene, mode of inheritance, or the primary reports for this disorder, so they are not stated here.

checks.claim: The disorder described in this entry is called Hoxha-Aliu syndrome, abbreviated HXAL.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 4 cited papers. Only the abstract was supplied. It describes a patient with a homozygous 8p23.1 deletion (ERI1, MFHAS1, miR-4660) but never names Hoxha-Aliu syndrome or the abbreviation HXAL.

paragraphs.text: The disorder is designated Hoxha-Aliu syndrome (HXAL), presumably after the authors of the report(s) that defined it. The defining publications, the clinical features and the molecular basis could not be recalled reliably enough to state here.

checks.claim: The disorder is designated Hoxha-Aliu syndrome (HXAL).
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 4 cited papers. Only the abstract was supplied, and it does not use the name Hoxha-Aliu syndrome or HXAL for this phenotype.

checks.claim: The name Hoxha-Aliu syndrome presumably comes from the authors of the report or reports that defined the disorder.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 4 cited papers. Only the abstract was supplied. It says nothing about where the name comes from, and the authors are Choucair et al., not Hoxha or Aliu.
